response.justification: Strong, long-tenured senior/staff-level generalist engineer (15+ years) with solid TypeScript/Node.js depth, distributed and high-throughput systems experience, testing/craftsmanship leadership, and demonstrable mentoring and public-speaking ability — all valuable for a customer-facing staff role. However, the core GenAI requirements are largely unmet: AI exposure is limited to roughly the last year (MCP code generators and agentic tooling at re:cinq), with no evidence of 8+ years shipping production AI, no Python listed, and no stated experience with vector databases, RAG architectures, multi-agent frameworks, LLM evaluation/observability, or cloud-native AI system design beyond AWS CDK application work. Could be worth a screen if the pipeline is thin and the team is willing to trade GenAI depth for engineering seniority and MCP familiarity.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production software; staff-level scope and mentoring/teaching track record
Deep TypeScript/Node.js plus AWS CDK, Docker, Kubernetes and high-throughput microservices experience
Hands-on MCP server/code-generator and agentic workflow tooling work at current role
concerns: Only ~1 year of AI-related work vs. the required 8+ years of AI-driven solutions
No RAG, vector database, LLM evaluation/optimization, or multi-agent framework experience shown
Python not listed among skills; no evidence of ML/data pipeline work on unstructured data
